import pandas as pd

# Read source tables with index_col=0 to ignore the numerical index column
source0 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length2_41/training_0.csv", index_col=0)
source1 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length2_41/training_1.csv", index_col=0)

# Join Source0 and Source1 on 'Mouse ID'
merged = pd.merge(source0, source1, on="Mouse ID", how="inner")

# Select and rename columns to match target schema
# Target schema: ['Drug': string, 'Timepoint': integer, 'Metastatic Sites': float]
# Ensure types: Drug as string, Timepoint as int, Metastatic Sites as float
result = merged[['Drug', 'Timepoint', 'Metastatic Sites']].copy()
result['Drug'] = result['Drug'].astype(str)
result['Timepoint'] = result['Timepoint'].astype(int)
result['Metastatic Sites'] = result['Metastatic Sites'].astype(float)

# Write the result to the target path without the index
result.to_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length2_41/target_multisource.csv", index=False)

import pandas as pd

# Read source tables with index_col=0 to ignore the first numerical index column
source0 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length2_41/training_0.csv", index_col=0)
source1 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length2_41/training_1.csv", index_col=0)

# Join on Mouse ID
joined = pd.merge(source0, source1, how='inner', left_on='Mouse ID', right_on='Mouse ID')

# Group by Drug and Timepoint, aggregate sum of Metastatic Sites
result = joined.groupby(['Drug', 'Timepoint'], as_index=False).agg({'Metastatic Sites': 'sum'})

# Ensure column order and types match target schema
result = result[['Drug', 'Timepoint', 'Metastatic Sites']]
result['Timepoint'] = result['Timepoint'].astype(int)
result['Metastatic Sites'] = result['Metastatic Sites'].astype(float)

# Write output
result.to_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length2_41/target_multisource_critique_history.csv", index=False)
